name: Gameplay Core Stabilization and Regression Tests
reason: Recent runtime tests found direction, interaction, special-match, and booster regressions. The puzzle engine must be reliable before level production, monetization integration, or content expansion.
deliverables: Pure C# BoardModel separated from visual cells
Gameplay state machine: Idle, Selecting, Swapping, Resolving, Falling, BoosterTargeting, Paused
Deterministic match grouping and cascade resolver
4-match, 5-match, T/L special creation and special-chain resolution
Booster preview, cancel, execute, inventory-consumption rules
QA debug overlay and test-board presets
acceptance_tests: Up, down, left, and right swaps map correctly
Single-tap adjacent movement and swipe movement agree
Invalid swap does not consume a move
Input is ignored while animation/resolution is active
All special shapes create the expected special
Special combinations chain without corrupting the board
Boosters only consume inventory after valid execution
Pause/resume preserves the exact board state
Approved gameplay layout and gem art remain unchanged
